title: Alam Aagaya
body:
shabbir ki aahon mein pyason ki ye goonji sada
alam aagaya alam aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
masoom sakina ne bachon ko bula kar kaha
alam aagaya alam aagaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne bhi hamein choda kis waqt e musibat mein
ab kaun sahara hai is aalam e ghurbat mein
abbas ke parcham se zainab ne lipat kar kaha
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun bachayega ay bhai ridaon ko
sunte nahi kya bhai bekas ki sadaon ko
zainab ne kaha ro kar chin jayegi sar se rida
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna tha yehi ran mein sab zulm ke maaron ka
zainab ne kiya matam ye kehke dulaaron ka
ab hum pe layeen ran mein dhayenge jafa par jafa
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein aaye thay hum jis ke sahare par
wo sher to sota hai ab darya kinare par
ab tu hi muhafiz hai hum ahle haram ka khuda
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein sakina ka jab aakhri waqt aaya
aise mein zafar us ne sajjad ko rulwaya
darwaza e zindan par masooma ne ro kar kaha
alam aagaya alam aagaya
shabbir ki aahon mein...
author: Zafar Abbas
